description: This file defines a Drupal plugin class 'Rss' that formats comment entities as RSS feed items within the Drupal views system.

classes.name: Rss
classes.description: A plugin class that formats comments as RSS items for Drupal views.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Loads comment entities based on IDs from the result set before rendering.

methods.name: buildOptionsForm_summary_options
methods.description: Builds options for the view's summary display, including a 'Title only' mode.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Generates the RSS item structure for a given comment row, including metadata and content.
